model_feature_assumption: All 23 declared socioeconomic indicators are used as raw CSV values; province code, name, year, source predictions, and old classes are excluded.
target_unit: Korban per 100.000 penduduk (sesuai referensi dashboard pengguna; tidak tersedia dalam header CSV).
risk_threshold_method: Empirical 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of observed training outcomes, 2021–2023.

papua_display_mapping.description: For display only: use the unique source observation once in research metrics and same-year reference means.
papua_display_mapping.unavailable_2024_note: Data 2024 tidak tersedia karena pemekaran Papua membuat data tidak sebanding dengan tahun sebelumnya.

explanation_methods.shap: SHAP PermutationExplainer with 3 forward/reverse permutation pairs (max_evals=139), seed 67; each year uses every unique available source-province feature row. Baseline is the same-year unweighted mean model prediction. This is a sampled interventional attribution, not TreeSHAP.
explanation_methods.lime: LIME local linear surrogate, 3,000 perturbations, seed 67, continuous features not discretized. Coefficients are local surrogate weights, not additive SHAP contributions.

methodology: Random Forest multi-target (400 trees, max_depth 10, min_samples_leaf 1, max_features sqrt, random seed 67) using the 23 declared socioeconomic indicators. Fit 2021–2023; hold out 2024. Source prediction columns are checked against the refit model. Risk cutoffs are training-derived relative tertiles. SHAP and LIME describe the fitted model and do not establish causal effects. Historical Papua source observations are mapped for display only; they are not duplicated in metrics or reference means. No claim of independent paper agreement is made.
